notes.title: Doors & Windows! Interactive Objects Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

The past month has seen many small performance and bug-fix updates, but also the addition of two types of interactive objects to War Dust gameplay!  Windows which break when bullets or rockets hit them, and doors which are controlled in-game by pressing buttons or grabbing knobs on the interior or exterior of buildings. There are plans for more of these types of interactive objects in War Dust, so keep an eye out for more! 


Changelog:

added breakable windows.
They are placed in various places in many maps, mostly where usually windows are 😄
To break windows you need to shoot it with your gun or with projectile (stinger, tank etc.)
Planned (no ETA) : 
breaking by driving vehicle through it, by hand punch, by weapon itself hit, by throwable items. At the moment bots won't see you through it, it will be looked after as well at some stage.

Added interactive gates and doors on some maps.

How to use them :
- to open/close the gate touch corresponding red button with your controller. Each gate have 2 buttons on each side. 
- you can't open/close the gate while it's opening/closing, you need to wait for the process to finish

-Added hundreds of interactive doors. There are 3 types, 2 wooden ones and 1 metal one. They are all rusty, rotten and squeaky 😉 
To open the door just touch the handle with your controller, it will open itself.  There is a little cooling time before you can close it or open it again (to be sure that all players received information over the network)
One thing to note : when opening the door you will be moved towards door opening direction for 1 second. This is the moment when you don't have control over your avatar.

notes.title: New Year Update!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Happy New Year! The last two months we have been overhauling War Dust game code to squeeze out more performance than ever, so we can move forward adding new features and mechanics to War Dust this year. Please be aware that with this type of thorough code optimization new bugs will result and we need everyone to be active communicating with us, especially on Raptor Lab Discord, to help fix those issues a.s.a.p.

Changelog:

- Month of work with code optimizations ! I hope it was worth it
- Reworked Kaoh Kreik (new shaders, real time light, more objects, more details, dynamic weather, underwater effect and many many more). Other variants are disabled at the moment. Only one variant of it is available, but it will repeat more often for a while.
- Mercenaries skins are brightened to better match coalition skins
- Added bullet holes system.
- Transport helis got audio boosted.
- Frags should kill after the owner's death (even if you hold armed frag in your hand)
- Replaced protective force field on Dubai with tents
- Improved water shader on maps
- Autosquad is disabled, please use manual squadding now. Squads should be limited to 5. If you see squad letter in green means, you are in. Choose "none" to be in none squad
- Added different hit icon when headshot (O)
- Increased damage of landmines a bit (due to speed of pro loco players, they were surviving them)
- Bots running speed was increased about 15-20%
- Nerfed Apaches fire power

notes.title: Another Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33756506/68f68944eb4dd30babfbaeba61fbb368daab41c4.png

Hello! New WarDust update is up on steam!

Some of you probably noticed that in the last couple of days there was little update every day. 
This post collects all features added recently plus new ones today.
So let's start.

- Added 4 new leaderboards. 
1)  Lifetime scores. 
2) Monthly scores
3) Kills by knife only, monthly
4) Best killers against real players only. Amount of kills minus deaths (also from real players only) will be the score added to your stats. cleared monthly
We are not sure if this is final version, we might add different leaderboards or replace existing ones. Maybe monthly will be replaced to weekly ones. We will see. It's still getting its shape.
Your score will be uploaded to leaderboard only when there was more than 5 real players in the match. Score is synced when the match is over.
Please also note that we can detect anyone that will start to tinker with personal score to be at the top of the leaderboard. In that case perma ban will be applied for leaderboards feature. Play fair, win fair, have fun fair.
Please read the update to privacy policy agreement right at the start of the game

- Voice chat in game options will now mute your voice and others completely.

- Added possibility to mute any player in game (for example the one you don't really like  ). Simply click on his/her name on the scoreboard. You will also see there, who is muted in their personal options.

- Spectator now will be muted (edited)

- Added various stats to score board. 
1) Knife kills (total kills includes that figure). Please note that knife kills gives you 5 times more points.
2) Shot accuracy. Percentage of shots fired and shots that hit the enemy
3) Current player class icons
4) Speaker icon (muted/not muted)

- Further tweaks on spawn room and GUI

- Added experimental home base protection in Dubai (X and Y)

- Adjusted AWP collision, to prevent situations when you were not be able to shoot when gun was too close to other objects.

- Every throwable item (like frag etc.) will now be frame rate independent. That means throwing frags will always work correctly, even when your frame rate drops significantly (no more your own frag drops below your feet). Same should apply to pro loco.

- Added custom server admin panel. When you host your own server you can :
1) Send horn signal to others (for example to start league match)
2) Save finished match stats to text file. 
3) Restart map/server any time you want.
4) Kick player out 
5) Kill all players (I don't know why I added this, but maybe someone is sadist and might need it)

- Fixed Kaoh Kreik character controller bug. Issues with stairs etc. (apologize for that, I thought I fixed it last week, probably forgot to press save button)

- And cherry on the top. When player is killed with explosion, it will be thrown to the sky, screaming like a mad man

notes.title: New Landmines Update!
notes.notes:
UPDATE:  We have reverted to the last stable build before landmines update, due to bugs related to the new connection manager.  We are working on fixing these and appreciate your patience.  Thank you for playing War Dust!

Previous announcement: 

Hello everyone,

-Added landmines to each class. Can be used against vehicles and infantry. It has 5 minutes of lifetime. Red ones should kill you (enemy's or yours), blue ones shouldn't (friendly). To arm it, just pull a pin (same as in frag grenade) and place it on the ground (make sure it’s placed red part up). Watch your steps!   On night maps they should be emissive.   They should also change color after you switch teams (spawned Blue should change to red and vice versa). It won't happen right away, but it should. For now landmines are available for each class, but it might change. They are not final, so bugs might occur also more features and tweaks will be added to them in following weeks.

-Added collision on tank turret, so it should be easier to hit the tank from the side.

-Frag grenades should cause little more damage to vehicles when exploded nearby

- New blood system, also not final yet.

-Major changes to room connection logic in netcode. This should fix: black screens, please waits, rooms when too many players and all these nasty things we were facing for years. No more patching, it's full rework of this code area.

notes.title: Mid week update

-Further optimization on netcode

-Added single player mode with official rotation

-Added 2 new region servers : EU(Amsterdam) and ASIA(Tokyo). Please note that once you are for example on the EU server, you won’t be able to play with US server players. To see the amount of players in a certain region, please switch to it and check Server Stats in the main menu.

-Added game options to spawn room (currently on right hand side, but this is not the final place).

-Added synchronization of players level/rank, so for example beside names on the scoreboard, you can see other players' level (5 different colors of stars, from darkest to gold). Rank is calculated from average level on all classes. Star changing color every 10, max is 50.

-Added nearly 200 cheaper (for GPU) material/shader versions for fastest settings, it should decrease GPU load. And because of this shaders stripping I added back post processing on fastest settings.

-Fixed spawning under the map on the Middle East, removed collision on tent ropes, fixed missing wall.

-Added script that detects players in spawn room with weapons and prevents killing others there .
Increased distance of explosion sound on frag and sticky.
If a player lands in a full room, it should be moved back to the "search for new room" event , hopefully no more rooms with above cap players amount (46).

-Players attacking home base (X or Y) won’t cause any damage to other players in their home base anymore (anti spawn camping solution, vehicles still can be destroyed) .

- Some tweaks on Terrain material on Kaoh Kreik maps

notes.title: New Map Update!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

WarDust got a bigger update!

- Added Orlov Refinery Night version map, so we now have Day and Night versions!
- Optimized Orlov Refinery (day) performance (still some space for improvement)
- Added night vision. To enable/disable it, move your hand close to your head and press the grip button
- Redone light on Desert Parables night
- Improved (I hope) performance when explosions and projectiles are spawned. Due to completely new spawn system possibility of new bugs. please report if any related to these objects.
- Optimized particles, like fire, smoke etc. Hopefully they will cause lower GPU load now.
- Shotgun and AWP have way bigger vertical recoil when shot one hand to make kind of cooling time between shots 
- Tweaked Sticky Bomb. It has way bigger damage, but also decreased damage distance. I'd say about 2 to destroy tank (it depends where you stick it on tank)
- Increased server tick rate 20%. Possibility of unwanted side effects, like lag when lot of players in room. Please report it in that case.

Lot of tweaks focused on giving higher chances to new players against game and experienced players
- Increased damage on all guns for players below xp level 20 (was 10)
- Increased speed about 10-20% for thumbstick movement players (also jumping on edges should be easier)
- Decreased Pro Loco slide/speed about 10% 
- More variety in bots level. More easier bots and less accurate ones.
Please note that these changes are not final.

Unfortunately had to temporarily revert transport helicopters to the old version. 
I'm guessing it was cause of random performance drops on Kaoh Kriek maps. We will see.

Please restart your steam to get this update.

notes.title: Mid week update
notes.notes:
Hello soldiers!

In this update :
- Increased room cap from 40 to 46 real players. 
- Fixed not working next room creation if room1 is full. If room1 is full, then room2 will be created. Players should stay in this room for next matches. If you want to join room1 (for example it's not full anymore), you need to go back to main menu (button on right side in spawn room) and join official rotation, then game will choose first free room available. Information about which room currently you are in is available in spawn room on stats window (right hand side). This was the cause of problems with joining game on Sunday (40 player cap, 50 players in game), room1 was full, room2 didn't exist.
- Added VERY EARLY PROTOTYPE of sticky bomb.(thanks @Evol Hardy for making model). Because it's based on frag grenade, to arm it , you need to pull pin like in frag, it's in the middle, where red cube is. Velocity of throw is 50% of frag as a initial stat. . Handy for Tanks. Engineer class only.
Opened for any suggestions here about damage, throw, timer, respawn timer etc. It sticks to vehicles only (can be modified to stick to anything if needed). It's very rough version, so it will take a while to make it perfect. It will be also remodeled to have some visible pin to pull (now it's just default from frag)

notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33756506/329e9c5b71227f124ed5a2054bb13aaffa58fad1.jpg

Hello everyone, thank you for playing War Dust, I hope you are having fun in the game!

We just released a new update for War Dust focusing on fixing bugs and bringing private modded rooms protected by password.

We decreased the XP needed to unlock new items to accelerate your progression in the game(5X faster).

We nerfed chopper efficiency on siege of dubai to avoid easy spawn killing.

We also just started a special 50% off promotion for the game during the next two weeks! If you have friends who are hesitating to jump into the game, now is the time!


Here is The Changelog:

- Reworked weapon and grenade handling
- Bullets are now visible in magazine if it's not empty and are now actually removed from the mag when manually ejecting them

- Modding
	- Added pin code to create private custom server
	- Improved vehicle stats compatibilites between types
	- Added more vehicle stats
	- Added more examples in template
	- Added error printing for modder
		- An editor script is available to print those errors in template's console
	
- Balancing on Siege of Dubai :
	- Remove 2 Apaches from aircraft-carrier
	- Increased respawn time for apaches
	
- Bugfixes :
	- UI elements (except players icon) aren't displayed anymore inside scopes, offering clearer line of sight
	- Homing missiles now track correctly locked vehicles
	- Fixed diverse issues uppon map loading
	- Fixed a bug where grenade were clipping through terrain
	- Fixed weird trees and bushes on Desert Parables

notes.title: Update 19/02/2020 WORKSHOP INTEGRATION !
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33756506/8fa7bb3202530492a7acbba63b0681052cfaca51.png

Hello everyone!

Thank you for playing War Dust!

We have the pleasure to announce that we officially released MOD COMPATIBILITY through the Steam WorkShop on the main branch of WAR DUST!

We want to thank all the people who helped us making it possible by creating awesome mods and reporting bugs!

You can now create and upload your own custom maps and vehicles on the workshop. it also allow basic script support.

If you want to create your own mods please follow this documentation.

If you want to get involved in the development process, you can subscribe to the beta branch to benefit from the last updates.
Don't hesitate to report your issues and let us know about your creations on Discord


Change Log :

- Workshop Integration
- Custom map integration
- Custom server browser
- Basic script support
- Custom Vehicles


Our Main focus will now be on Mod support and offering as many possibility to the modders to build what they want and
to allow people to discover, share and enjoy mods easily.

The next steps of this adventure will be:
- Character mod support
- Weapon mod support
